refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.BootControl is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
# Boot Loader control APIs interface io.systemd.BootControl
# The type of a boot entry type BootEntryType( # Boot Loader Specification Type #1 entries (.conf files) type1, # Boot Loader Specification Type #2 entries (UKIs) type2, # Additional entries reported by boot loader loader, # Automatically generated entries auto )
# The source of a boot entry type BootEntrySource( # Boot entry found in EFI system partition (ESP) esp, # Boot entry found in XBOOTLDR partition xbootldr )
# The operation to execute type Operation( # Install the boot loader afresh, creating everything it needs new, # Just update existing boot loader binaries update )
# The boot entry token type to use. type BootEntryTokenType( # Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on /etc/machine-id machine_id, # Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on the IMAGE_ID= field from /etc/os-release os_image_id, # Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on the ID= field from /etc/os-release os_id, # Pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries based on a manually chosen string literal, # Choose automatically how to pick identifiers for type #1 boot entries auto )
# A structure encapsulating an addon of a boot entry type BootEntryAddon( # The location of the global addon. globalAddon: ?string, # The location of the local addon. localAddon: ?string, # The command line options by the addon. options: ?string )
# An additional file to install type BootEntryExtraFile( # The name of the extra file filename: string, # Index into array of file descriptors, pointing to a file descriptor referencing the extra file to copy in. Either this or the 'data' field below must be set – not both, not neither. fileDescriptor: ?int, # Literal data to place in the extra file. data: ?string )
# A structure encapsulating a boot entry type BootEntry( type: BootEntryType, # The source of the entry source: BootEntrySource, # The string identifier of the entry id: ?string, # Path to the primary definition file for the entry path: ?string, # Directory path of the file system root the entry was found on root: ?string, # The entry's title string title: ?string, # The possibly mangled/augmented title to show for the entry showTitle: ?string, # An explicitly configured sorting key for the enry sortKey: ?string, # The version of the entry version: ?string, # The kernel version from the UKI's .uname section uname: ?string, # Machine ID of the OS installation belonging to the entry, if known machineId: ?string, # EFI architecture name for this entry architecture: ?string, # Command line options to pass to the invoked kernel or EFI binary options: ?string, # Path to the Linux kernel to invoke, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file linux: ?string, # Path to the EFI binary to invoke, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file efi: ?string, # Path to an UKI EFI binary to invoke, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file uki: ?string, # An UKI profile index to invoke. If not specified defaults to the first profile. profile: ?int, # Path to the initrd image to pass to the invoked kernel, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file initrd: ?[]string, # Devicetree file to pass to the invoked kernel, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file devicetree: ?string, # Devicetree overlay file to pass to the invoked kernel, relative to the root directory of the file system containing the entry file devicetreeOverlay: ?[]string, # Indicates whether the boot loader reported this entry on the current boot isReported: bool, # Indicates the number of tries left for this boot entry before it is assumed to be not working. triesLeft: ?int, # Indicates the number of unsuccessful tries already made for this boot entry. triesDone: ?int, # Indicates whether this entry is the default entry. isDefault: ?bool, # Indicates whether this entry has been booted. isSelected: ?bool, # Addon images of the entry. addons: ?[]BootEntryAddon, # Extra files associated with the entry. extras: ?[]string, # Command line options of the entry. cmdline: ?string )
# Enumerates boot entries. Method call must be called with 'more' flag set. Each response returns one entry. If no entries are defined returns the NoSuchBootEntry error. # [Requires 'more' flag] method ListBootEntries() -> ( # A boot menu entry structure entry: BootEntry )
# Sets the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag of the firmware, if this concept exists. Returns the RebootToFirmwareNotSupported error if not. method SetRebootToFirmware( # The new value of the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag state: bool ) -> ()
# Gets the current state of the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag of the firmware, if this concept exists. Returns the RebootToFirmwareNotSupported error if not. method GetRebootToFirmware() -> ( # The current state of the reboot-to-firmware-UI flag state: bool )
# Install the boot loader on the ESP. method Install( # Operation, either 'new' or 'update' operation: Operation, # If true, continue on various failures graceful: ?bool, # Index into array of file descriptors passed along with this message, pointing to file descriptor to root file system to operate on rootFileDescriptor: ?int, # Root directory to operate relative to. If both this and rootFileDescriptor is specified, this is purely informational. If only this is specified, it is what will be used. rootDirectory: ?string, # Path to the EFI System Partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the ESP is auto-discovered. espPath: ?string, # Path to the XBOOTLDR partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the XBOOTLDR partition is auto-discovered. xbootldrPath: ?string, # Selects how to identify boot entries bootEntryTokenType: ?BootEntryTokenType, # Whether to create the '$BOOT/ENTRY-TOKEN/' directory for Boot Loader Specification Type #1 snippets. If not specified this is decided automatically. makeEntryDirectory: ?bool, # If true the boot loader will be registered in an EFI boot entry via EFI variables, otherwise this is omitted touchVariables: ?bool ) -> ()
# Unlink a boot menu item method Unlink( # Index into array of file descriptors passed along with this message, pointing to file descriptor to root file system to operate on rootFileDescriptor: ?int, # Root directory to operate relative to. If both this and rootFileDescriptor is specified, this is purely informational. If only this is specified, it is what will be used. rootDirectory: ?string, # Path to the EFI System Partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the ESP is auto-discovered. espPath: ?string, # Path to the XBOOTLDR partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the XBOOTLDR partition is auto-discovered. xbootldrPath: ?string, # Selects how to identify boot entries bootEntryTokenType: ?BootEntryTokenType, # The ID of the boot loader entry to remove. id: ?string, # If true, remove the oldest entry. oldest: ?bool ) -> ()
# Install a kernel as boot menu item method Link( # Index into array of file descriptors passed along with this message, pointing to file descriptor to root file system to operate on rootFileDescriptor: ?int, # Root directory to operate relative to. If both this and rootFileDescriptor is specified, this is purely informational. If only this is specified, it is what will be used. rootDirectory: ?string, # Path to the EFI System Partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the ESP is auto-discovered. espPath: ?string, # Path to the XBOOTLDR partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the XBOOTLDR partition is auto-discovered. xbootldrPath: ?string, # Selects how to identify boot entries bootEntryTokenType: ?BootEntryTokenType, # The entry title for the newly created boot menu entry entryTitle: ?string, # The entry version for the newly created boot menu entry entryVersion: ?string, # The commit number for the newly created boot menu entry entryCommit: ?int, # Target filename for the kernel image (UKI) in the $BOOT partition kernelFilename: string, # Index into array of file descriptors passed along with this message, pointing to file descriptor to the kernel image to copy kernelFileDescriptor: int, # An array of 'extra' files for this entry, i.e. credentials, confexts, sysexts, addons. extraFiles: ?[]BootEntryExtraFile, # What to set the triesLeft counter of the boot menu entry to initially. triesLeft: ?int, # How much space to always keep free on ESP/XBOOTLDR. Defaults to 1 MiB keepFree: ?int ) -> ( # The IDs of the created boot loader entries. ids: []string )
# Like Link(), but automatically discovers the UKI and extra resources staged below /var/lib/systemd/uki/ method LinkAuto( # Index into array of file descriptors passed along with this message, pointing to file descriptor to root file system to operate on rootFileDescriptor: ?int, # Root directory to operate relative to. If both this and rootFileDescriptor is specified, this is purely informational. If only this is specified, it is what will be used. rootDirectory: ?string, # Path to the EFI System Partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the ESP is auto-discovered. espPath: ?string, # Path to the XBOOTLDR partition mount point, resolved relative to rootDirectory/rootFileDescriptor if either is set. If not specified the XBOOTLDR partition is auto-discovered. xbootldrPath: ?string, # Selects how to identify boot entries bootEntryTokenType: ?BootEntryTokenType, # The entry title for the newly created boot menu entry entryTitle: ?string, # The entry version for the newly created boot menu entry entryVersion: ?string, # The commit number for the newly created boot menu entry entryCommit: ?int, # What to set the triesLeft counter of the boot menu entry to initially. triesLeft: ?int, # How much space to always keep free on ESP/XBOOTLDR. Defaults to 1 MiB keepFree: ?int ) -> ( # The IDs of the created boot loader entries. ids: []string )
# SetRebootToFirmware() and GetRebootToFirmware() return this if the firmware does not actually support the reboot-to-firmware-UI concept. error RebootToFirmwareNotSupported()
# No boot entry defined. error NoSuchBootEntry()
# No EFI System Partition (ESP) found. error NoESPFound()
# Neither ESP nor XBOOTLDR found, hence no $BOOT location identified. error NoDollarBootFound()
# The selected boot entry token could not be determined. error BootEntryTokenUnavailable()
# The specified kernel image is not valid. error InvalidKernelImage()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.BootControl shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.BootControl.ListBootEntries '{}' invokes its ListBootEntries method.
